title: Bayesian Cable Curl
summary: A one-arm cable curl facing away from a low pulley, with your arm behind your body, so the biceps are stretched at the bottom.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.25 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Set a cable low, take the handle and step forward until your arm is pulled behind you.
Curl up without letting your elbow swing forward.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight behind you.

form_cues.cue: Keep the elbow behind your torso
Stagger your stance and lean forward a little to keep the arm back.

mistakes.text: Letting the elbow swing forward during the curl.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less biceps long-head stretch, Peak-contraction focus.
Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Less constant tension.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
